## Summary
- The full media sync landed today (cutover), so the derived-photo sweeper no longer needs to skip vehicles above the folder Delta's earlier migration stopped at.
- Remove `--tot-wagen=20710` from the scheduled `stocklist:fotos-afgeleid` command in `routes/console.php` and rewrite the comment: what the sweeper does, that it now covers every vehicle, and that the one-off backlog run is the four shards from `CUTOVER.md` step 6.
- Mark the `--tot-wagen=20710` removal as done in `CUTOVER.md` (both the day-card step 6 line and the detailed checklist item); the one-off `--opnieuw` backfill of the pre-cutover backlog stays open.

## Test plan
- [x] `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'Schedule|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity'` — 9 tests, 9 passed.
params.title: The derived-photo sweeper covers every vehicle
